Images.Caption: An in-game screenshot of a red-trimmed Norse village from Age of Mythology: Retold. The village is framed by a tall wooden wall at the southern end and large autumnal trees on the northern end. There is a stone pathway that runs through the village and has several units, including giants, walking down south. NIdhogg (a mythical dragon) is flying over the right side of the image, just above a destroyed longhouse. Storm clouds and mountain peaks appear just beyond the northern treeline.

NIdhogg (a mythical dragon) is flying over the right side of the image, just above a destroyed longhouse. Storm clouds and mountain peaks appear just beyond the northern treeline.

An in-game screenshot from Age of Mythology: Retold. A snowy red-trimmed Norse village is shown. The town center sits at the center, surrounded by farms. Longhouses, among other buildings, surrounded the farms. Just north is a shoreline with several red-stripped viking ships sitting in the water. Ox carts, units, and myth units can be seen traversing the area.

Longhouses, among other buildings, surrounded the farms. Just north is a shoreline with several red-stripped viking ships sitting in the water. Ox carts, units, and myth units can be seen traversing the area.

An in-game screenshot of Age of Mythology: Retold. A large yellow-trimmed Egyptian city is shown. A massive pyramid sits in the lower right corner, surrounded by a multitude of myth units. Just above the pyramid sits a town center and several stone buildings. To the east, a rocky cliff facade frames the city. To the right is a long stone wall keeping a red-trimmed Atlantean army back. Myth and human units, from both armies, are combating one another. The Egyptian titan, a humanoid being with a bird's head, is displayed above the city with fiery wings.

Myth and human units, from both armies, are combating one another. The Egyptian titan, a humanoid being with a bird's head, is displayed above the city with fiery wings.

An in-game screenshot of a blue-trimmed Atlantean city from Age of Mythology: Retold. The town center sits at the center with farms surrounding it. Beyond the farms is a stone pathway that encircles it all. Several units on horseback and automatons traverse the path. Beyond the path are several manors and other buildings, reaching out to a large body of water to the north. An oracle stands at the lower left of the image surrounded by a large purple circle of magic.

Beyond the path are several manors and other buildings, reaching out to a large body of water to the north. An oracle stands at the lower left of the image surrounded by a large purple circle of magic.

An in-game screenshot from Age of Mythology: Retold highlighting a massive battle between a blue-trimmed army and a red-trimmed army. Large red-trimmed stone buildings are heavily damaged and on fire. A lightning bolt is striking the ground just north of the buildings. Near the lightning strike stands Cerberus. Several myth units are converging around the center, including Medusa, Nemean Lions, and Automatons.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
From the creators of the award-winning Age of Empires franchise, Age of Mythology: Retold goes beyond history to a mythical age where gods, monsters, and humans collide. Combining the best elements of the beloved Age of Mythology with modern real-time strategy design and visuals, Retold is an epic and innovative experience for old and new players alike. Secure your domain, command legendary monsters, and call upon the power of the gods to crush your enemies.  

 

Will you become Mythic?  

 

Call Upon the Gods  
Choose your gods from the Greek, Norse, Egyptian, and Atlantean pantheons. Devastate your enemies by summoning powerful lightning storms, earth-shattering quakes, and even the famed Nidhogg dragon. Or call upon nourishing rains and protective Dryads to help your people grow & prosper.  

Unleash the Monsters  
Unleash Centaurs, Trolls, Mummies, and more. From bejeweled crocodiles who harness the power of the sun to the mighty one-eyed Cyclops, you will command diverse units inspired by the world’s great mythologies.  

Limitless Adventure, Solo or with Friends  
Experience Age of Mythology: Retold like never before. In the main game, go head-to-head with friends or challenge the advanced AI across countless, randomly generated maps for endless strategic battles.  
 
For a fresh twist, step into Arena of the Gods—an all-new mode where you take on the role of a legendary hero, facing 35 mythic skirmishes filled with divine challenges. Play solo or join forces in co-op*, battling through epic trials from the frozen Tundra to the heights of Mount Olympus. Face world-changing twists and unlock godly blessings as you fight solo or with friends. 
 
Built for controller 
RTS on console? We’ve got you covered. Streamlined controls make it easy to build, battle, and conquer—all without a keyboard. 

*Requires Age of Mythology: Retold or Xbox Game Pass membership (Ultimate and PC only) 

**Online console multiplayer requires Game Pass Ultimate or Core, sold separately.
